messages:
dana-fin: Heads up — customer Zephyr (acct 7780) got two invoice emails with identical invoice_id INV-2026-07-09-7780 but different totals. One shows a split line (usage split due to rounding) and the other collapses them into a single line. Both sent.

orrin: I pulled the PDFs from S3. Looks like renderer created a second invoice when it hit a rounding edge and re-tried line normalization. First render total=12,345 cents, second render total=12,300 cents.

billing-bot: invoice-service: render_attempt=2 invoice_id=INV-2026-07-09-7780 status=sent duplicate_warning=true

eli-engineer: quick theory: ledger write made two invoice rows because line normalization created a transient where each line had a different rounding flag and the reconciliation logic treated them as different snapshots. Retry path didn't detect existing invoice_id because invoice_id is generated client-side after normalization.

hana-cs: Customer already paid the higher amount. They asked for immediate correction and apology. Can we void the overcharge and issue credit?

mike-ops: yes we can. Need finance signoff to issue credit memo and a CS note. Dana, can you confirm amount to credit?

dana-fin: Confirmed. Credit should be delta between paid invoice and corrected invoice + cover fees. Payment id=pay_zx11 at 08:22. delta=45 cents, processing fee coverage=300 cents. Total credit=345 cents. Approve if OK.

orrin: I ran a SQL check to show the duplicate rows and rounding flags:
```
SELECT id, invoice_id, total_cents, normalization_hash, rounding_strategy
FROM invoices
WHERE account_id = 7780 AND batch_date = '2026-07-09'
ORDER BY created_at;
```

eli-engineer: Mitigation plan: 1) make invoice_id generation happen before ledger write and persist idempotency_key on write, 2) add a reconciliation step in renderer to compare existing invoice_lines and fail-fast if snapshot mismatch, 3) add unit tests for rounding normalization boundary cases. I'll open a PR.

billing-bot: manual-regenerate queued: job=regen-2026-07-09-7780 requested_by=mike-ops ETA=2m

mike-ops: regen triggered with --force-normalize flag. Also voiding duplicate unpaid PDF (object: s3://billing-previews/INV-2026-07-09-7780-dup.pdf).

billing-bot: regen completed: job=regen-2026-07-09-7780 status=completed results: invoice corrected, credit_memo=CM-2026-07-09-7780 amount=345 cents processed=true pdfs_replaced=true

hana-cs: CS notified customer with apology and credit confirmation. Customer replied with thanks and asked for a short note about technical fix.

dana-fin: finance records updated, adding impact to FIN-Q2. Filing FIN-INV-389.

eli-engineer: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/p/billing/+/4012 — adds idempotency_key, prewrite invoice id, rounding tests. Scheduling deploy to staging.

mike-ops: postmortem action items: add smoke test to detect multiple PDFs for same invoice_id in a batch and alert, add histogram metric for normalization churn.

orrin: good call. Also toggling a short hold on auto-resend for renderer retries until idempotency is deployed.

dana-fin: thanks all, closing thread.
